title: Beegen comparison pages: competitor facts
description: Source of truth for every claim about a competitor on /comparar/ pages. A claim without a source URL and an access date cannot be rendered. Beegen's own prices and quotas never live here: they come from src/lib/modules.ts in abremers/beegen-platform at generation time.

correction_email.description: Shown on every page next to the verification date.

max_claim_age_days.description: A claim whose last access is older than this fails validation and must be re-verified or removed.

publisher.description: Who published the page, e.g. 'Leadsales (oficial)' or 'G2'.

kind.description: repo_research = a file in abremers/beegen-platform/docs/research; it can explain where a claim came from but never stands alone on a page that is indexable.

method.description: direct_fetch: the page was loaded and the quote found in it. human_check: a person opened the page and confirmed. search_excerpt: only a search-engine snippet was seen; allowed in drafts, blocks the page from going index.

quote.description: Shortest verbatim text from the source that supports the claim, in the source's language.

archive_url.description: Optional snapshot (web.archive.org) taken at access time.

id.description: Stable fact id, e.g. 'leadsales.price.basico'. Generated text cites facts by this id.

text_es.description: The claim as it may appear on the page, in es-MX, neutral and attributable. No adjectives about quality.

value.description: Machine value for tables and the numeric-consistency validator.

plan.description: Plan the claim applies to, when it is plan-specific.

excludes_tax.description: True when the competitor's price is shown before IVA. Pages must say so when comparing with Beegen's IVA-included prices.

evidence.description: Most recent first. The page's 'Información verificada el' date is the oldest accessed_at among the claims it renders.

conflicts.description: Known disagreement between sources. A claim with an unresolved conflict renders only the official figure or is left out.

status.description: verified requires at least one evidence item with method direct_fetch or human_check inside max_claim_age_days.

beegen_contrast.description: One row of the comparison table. Beegen's side is a reference into the platform registry, never a literal.

name.description: The competitor's name exactly as its owner writes it. Used as a word mark only, never a logo.

legal_owner.description: Company behind the product, when sourced.

framing.description: alternativa: 'Alternativa a X'; vs: 'Beegen vs X' only when both products serve the same job; complemento: 'Beegen y X' (Meta Business Agent).

target_queries.description: Queries the page is built for. Filled from Search Console once data exists; seeds before that.

beegen_modules.description: Modules the page links to and builds UTM signup links for. 'voice' is hidden in the registry and never listed.

when_competitor_fits_es.description: Honest cases where the competitor is the better choice. Required: a page without them reads as attack advertising.

indexable.description: The one-line flip. true is only valid when both approvals exist and their content_hash matches the rendered page.

content_hash.description: Hash of the rendered main content (claims plus generated blocks) the approver read. Any later change voids the approval.
